model_integration.model_use_meaning: Intended use after explicit mapping: parameter, scenario or context. Missing values remain missing. This ledger itself does not change model inputs or run calculations.

inputs.cohort: Mothers birthing in Queensland, usual residence CHHHS; facility total is a separate cohort
inputs.denominator: 2852 CHHHS-resident mothers for residence-based flows; 3066 mothers for CHHHS-facility activity
inputs.interpretation: Catchment and cross-HHS flows; not babies or neonatal consultations. Published table percentages are column percentages.

inputs.cohort: Mothers birthing in Queensland, usual residence TCHHS
inputs.interpretation: Regional catchment baseline. Reopening scenarios redistribute births instead of adding the same births to regional totals.

inputs.cohort: Queensland births, including stillbirths, home/freebirths and born before arrival
inputs.interpretation: Existing facility inventory remains usable. This ledger does not refresh or overwrite it. The total is not a matched denominator for livebirth transfers excluding BBA.

inputs.cohort: Queensland livebirth transfers; excludes born before arrival
inputs.denominator: 1508 recorded transferred livebirths; not all births or eligible consultation episodes

levels: L2 nursery and special care nursery
L3 nursery, special care nursery and NICU

inputs.interpretation: These are three nursery categories, not CSCF levels 1-6. Birth Other includes home/facilities without approved maternity services; transfer Other includes facilities without approved maternity services, interstate and unstated facilities. Transfers are not all escalation or avoidable.

inputs.unit: published records and distinct published Unique IDs
inputs.cohort: All records in the latest resource
inputs.interpretation: Records exceed distinct IDs by 593. Meaning of repeated IDs is unresolved. All ages are N/A. Do not equate rows or distinct IDs with neonatal episodes or silently deduplicate.

inputs.cohort: Illness Assessment = Certain conditions originating in the perinatal period; includes interstate referrals
inputs.interpretation: Diagnostic subgroup is not an age-defined neonatal cohort. Neonates can occur in other diagnostic categories. Not an eligible-contact count or neonatal incidence estimate.

inputs.cohort: Perinatal illness category AND Outcome = Transferred with Retrieval personnel
inputs.interpretation: Conditional descriptive mix. Duplicate-record meaning, missing modes and diagnostic rather than age-defined cohort prevent automatic replacement of neonatal mode parameters.

inputs.cohort: Relevant HHS transfers coordinated by RSQ under the directive

values.fixed_wing_payment_trigger: RSQ accepted referral and asset tasked
hhs_excluded_costs: retrieval medical staff provided by RSQ
values.mandatory_coordination: Aeromedical transfers and emergency paediatric, neonatal and high-risk obstetric road transfers requiring a retrieval team

inputs.interpretation: Defines scope and responsibility. Does not provide unit tariffs, cancellation charges or the fraction of cost saved when a transfer is avoided.

inputs.unit: births per stated calendar year; installed capability
inputs.interpretation: Candidate current-estate/volume scenario. Announcement reports video capability, not audited uptime or uptake. Existing model baseline has not been changed by adding this ledger.

inputs.denominator: Prospective full year; not observed annual births
inputs.interpretation: Scenario anchor, not an observed count or fitted distribution. Redistribute relevant regional births. Existing model baseline has not been changed by adding this ledger.

inputs.period: current contract and costing year required
inputs.unit: AUD per relevant journey, tasking, cancellation or variable resource use
inputs.cohort: CHHHS-relevant neonatal transfers by mode and route class
inputs.denominator: Completed journeys and cancellations, clearly separated from infants and legs
inputs.interpretation: No current neonatal per-journey tariffs or cancellable fractions verified in the public sources. Request a small aggregate contract/invoice summary; distinguish HHS financial and health-system resource perspectives.

inputs.period: Latest complete 12 months first; up to three complete years if readily available
inputs.unit: eligible distinct infant episodes and consultation contacts, separately
inputs.cohort: CHHHS urgent postnatal neonatal consultations in the agreed target population
inputs.denominator: Covered facilities and period, eligible distinct episodes, contact counts, missing follow-up
inputs.interpretation: Request aggregate counts for telephone/video availability and use, immediate transfer decision, subsequent transfer and transport mode. No unit-level records are required to populate these parameters.

uncertainty_rules: Published annual census counts are observed for their period. Future-year variation is distinct from uncertainty about those counts.
Use beta/binomial or Dirichlet models only with a matched cohort, denominator and explicit predictive or parameter interpretation.
Reported effect-estimate uncertainty, observational bias and setting transportability are separate dimensions; changing transportability does not rewrite the reported estimate.
Unknown tariff and avoidable-cost fractions require explicit assumptions or sourced ranges; do not create observations or intervals.
RSQ repeated IDs and missing age are classification and observation-unit limitations, not problems solved by a narrower probability distribution.

rsq_query_metadata.query: SELECT count(*) AS records, count(DISTINCT "Unique ID") AS unique_episode_ids, min("Request Date") AS first_request, max("Request Date") AS last_request, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "Referring HHS" IS NULL OR "Referring HHS" IN ('','N/A','NULL')) AS missing_referring_hhs FROM "51a298ce-0323-4381-80e9-8beb07f509c9"

SELECT "Referring HHS", count(*) AS n FROM "51a298ce-0323-4381-80e9-8beb07f509c9" WHERE "Illness Assessment" = 'Certain conditions originating in the perinatal period' GROUP BY "Referring HHS" ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT "Grouped Mode of Transport", "Outcome", count(*) AS n FROM "51a298ce-0323-4381-80e9-8beb07f509c9" WHERE "Illness Assessment" = 'Certain conditions originating in the perinatal period' GROUP BY "Grouped Mode of Transport", "Outcome" ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT "Age", count(*) AS n FROM "51a298ce-0323-4381-80e9-8beb07f509c9" GROUP BY "Age"
rsq_query_metadata.verification: Aggregate result observed in tool response; raw response bytes not retained.

rsq_query_notes: The whole_file_audit query alias unique_episode_ids counts distinct published Unique IDs; it does not validate that an ID represents an episode.
Only server-side aggregate counts were retrieved.
Do not infer trends from other datastore years without completeness checks: FY2023/24 returned 2000 records; FY2022/23 included many blank records.

recommended_chhhs_request.priority: First obtain a bounded annual aggregate; extend only where the current uncertainty changes a decision.
recommended_chhhs_request.period: Latest complete 12 months; up to three annual totals if already available
minimum: Covered facilities, inclusion criteria, period and missingness; separate contacts, distinct infants, journeys and legs.
Eligible urgent postnatal infant episodes and total consultations; telephone, attempted video, successful video and unknown.
Immediate transfer decision, subsequent transfer within 24 hours, later transfer, completed locally and unknown follow-up; distinguish urgent escalation from planned repatriation.
Completed transports and cancellations before/after tasking by road, fixed wing, rotary wing and mixed/unknown mode.
Actual attributable charges and cancellation rules, separately from average fully allocated service costs; existing equipment, implementation and recurring support cost.
optional_if_readily_available: Broad acuity or gestation bands if they would change eligibility or transportability assumptions.
Aggregate receiving bed-days and broad family travel/accommodation cost if a societal scenario is decision-relevant.
Monthly/site subdivisions only when counts, coverage and disclosure rules support them; annual CHHHS totals are a sufficient starting point.
recommended_chhhs_request.release: Use the existing approved aggregate process; distinguish suppressed, unknown and zero cells. No identifiers, exact patient dates or free text.

clinical_parameters.cohort: 317 term/late-preterm newborns receiving neonatal telephone or video consultation at six rural California hospitals, August 2014-June 2018
clinical_parameters.endpoint: Transfer within 24 hours; applying the association to eventual transfer is a model extrapolation
clinical_parameters.native_unit: adjusted odds ratio, video versus telephone

distribution.interpretation: Approximate uncertainty distribution for the reported adjusted association, centred on reported log OR; rounded CI endpoints need not reconstruct exactly.

clinical_parameters.notes: Retain the reported estimate. Evaluate observational bias and transportability in separate named scenarios; do not recenter the evidence silently.

clinical_parameters.cohort: Eight Intermountain community hospitals, 2013-2017; 44643 births aggregated into 394 facility-month observations
clinical_parameters.endpoint: Transfers from community hospital to level 3 NICU per facility-month
clinical_parameters.native_unit: adjusted difference in transfers per facility-month

distribution.interpretation: Approximate uncertainty in the native reported average marginal difference; not an absolute count draw.

separate_reported_result.interpretation: Reduction in odds, not a percentage reduction in risk. No unreported odds-ratio CI is created.

clinical_parameters.notes: Requires explicit facility-month activity and population mapping before use. Overlaps the Intermountain program and period evaluated by Maddox; do not pool as independent evidence.

clinical_parameters.cohort: Intermountain infants born 2013-2017, at least 34 weeks, oxygen within 15 minutes; selected mandatory-transfer conditions excluded; transfer model 639 observations
clinical_parameters.endpoint: Transfer to NICU in the selected study population
clinical_parameters.native_unit: adjusted absolute risk difference, probability scale

distribution.interpretation: Approximate uncertainty in the reported average marginal risk difference: -12 percentage points, not a 12 percent relative reduction.

clinical_parameters.notes: Map baseline risk and population before applying as a probability change, retaining valid probability bounds. Do not convert this marginal difference into an OR or pool independently with Albritton.

clinical_parameters.cohort: 209 transferred neonates at six rural California hospitals, April 2014-June 2018; 47 video and 162 telephone consultations
clinical_parameters.endpoint: Adjusted mean difference in stabilisation time among transferred infants

distribution.interpretation: Uncertainty in a mean time difference, including shorter and longer stabilisation; not a distribution of individual stabilisation times.

clinical_parameters.notes: Requires a time outcome and relevant cost/resource mapping before use. The interval includes zero; no survival, safety or mortality effect is inferred.

clinical_parameter_rules: These native-unit distributions make the reported estimates usable and explicit; they do not manufacture additional observations.
Only the Haynes transfer odds ratio maps directly to the current OR kernel. Other outcomes require explicit outcome, cohort and unit mapping before economic aggregation.
Albritton and Maddox evaluate overlapping Intermountain program periods; do not combine them as independent estimates.
Normal approximations describe uncertainty in reported mean or marginal differences. They are not predictive distributions of individual patients, event counts or durations.
